nodes.description: Implements a two-stage interaction pattern: a primary LM generates a free-form response, followed by a dedicated, smaller LM that extracts structured data from that response. Ideal for LMs that excel at reasoning but struggle with direct structured output.

nodes.label: Define Program Structure
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: Specifies the input and output fields, along with instructions, for a DSPy module. This definition guides adapters on how to format prompts and interpret LM responses.

nodes.label: Interact with Language Models
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: The abstract interface that all language models in DSPy adhere to, providing standardized methods for making synchronous and asynchronous calls to various LM providers.

nodes.label: Represent Callable Tools
nodes.title: DSPy Tool
nodes.description: A data type representing an external function or capability that a language model can be instructed to invoke, often used in conjunction with native function calling features.

nodes.label: Parse LM Tool Invocations
nodes.title: DSPy ToolCalls
nodes.description: A structured data type used to represent and parse tool invocation requests generated by a language model, including the tool's name and its arguments.

nodes.label: Manage Conversation Context
nodes.title: DSPy History
nodes.description: A data structure that maintains the chronological sequence of messages exchanged in a conversation, providing essential context for subsequent language model interactions.

nodes.label: Extract Structured Data via Chat
nodes.title: ChatAdapter
nodes.description: A specialized adapter, often used with smaller LMs, designed to extract structured information from free-form text by framing the extraction task as a chat-based interaction.

nodes.label: Define Structured Data Schemas
nodes.title: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.description: An external library component for defining data models with robust validation and serialization capabilities, leveraged by adapters like BAMLAdapter for structured output generation.

nodes.label: Handle Custom DSPy Types
nodes.title: DSPy Type
nodes.description: The base class for custom DSPy data types, enabling adapters to provide specialized handling or leverage native LM features for specific output formats like citations or reasoning steps.

groups.label: User-Facing Adapters
groups.title: User-Facing Adapters
groups.description: Concrete adapter implementations that users configure and interact with to customize how DSPy programs communicate with Language Models, influencing prompt generation and output parsing.

groups.label: Core Adapter Logic
groups.title: Core Adapter Logic
groups.description: The foundational abstract class defining the common interface and lifecycle for all DSPy adapters. It handles the transformation of DSPy signatures into LM prompts and the parsing of LM responses.

groups.label: Data Structures & Types
groups.title: Data Structures & Types
groups.description: External and internal data structures that adapters process, format, or extract. This includes DSPy signatures, tool definitions, conversation history, and custom data types.

groups.label: LM Interaction Helpers
groups.title: LM Interaction Helpers
groups.description: Components that facilitate interaction with Language Models, encompassing the base LM interface and specialized adapters used for specific tasks like structured data extraction.

retrievers.title: Retrieval Modules and Utilities
retrievers.description: This module provides various retrieval mechanisms, including local and remote ColBERTv2, Databricks Vector Search, and Weaviate, to fetch relevant passages for a given query. It also includes a generic retrieval interface and utilities for text processing and result formatting.

nodes.label: Generic Document Retrieval
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.retrieve.Retrieve
nodes.description: Provides a standardized interface for retrieving documents based on a query, delegating to the configured Retrieval Model (RM).

nodes.label: Retrieve from Databricks Vector Search
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.databricks_rm.DatabricksRM
nodes.description: Connects to and queries a Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search Index to fetch relevant documents.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Weaviate
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.weaviate_rm.WeaviateRM
nodes.description: Interacts with a Weaviate collection to find and return top passages for a given query.

nodes.label: Query Remote ColBERTv2 Service
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.ColBERTv2
nodes.description: Communicates with a remote ColBERTv2 endpoint to perform document retrieval using GET or POST requests.

nodes.label: Manage Local ColBERTv2 Index
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.ColBERTv2RetrieverLocal
nodes.description: Builds, loads, and searches a local ColBERTv2 index from a collection of passages for efficient retrieval.

nodes.label: Rerank Passages Locally (ColBERTv2)
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.ColBERTv2RerankerLocal
nodes.description: Reranks a list of passages based on a query using a local ColBERTv2 model to improve relevance.

nodes.label: Retrieve Embeddings with Scores
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.embeddings.EmbeddingsWithScores
nodes.description: Extends basic embedding retrieval to also return similarity scores alongside passages and indices, enabling more nuanced results.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Configuration
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.settings.Settings
nodes.description: Manages global DSPy settings, including the currently active Retrieval Model (RM), which dictates the default retrieval behavior.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text for DPR
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.dpr.SimpleTokenizer
nodes.description: A basic tokenizer used for processing text, particularly in the context of Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) and related models.

nodes.label: Locate Answers in Text
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.dpr.locate_answers
nodes.description: Identifies and returns character offsets for occurrences of answers within a given tokenized text.

nodes.label: Load Batch Backgrounds
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.utils.load_batch_backgrounds
nodes.description: Utility function to load background passages for a batch of queries, often used in specific DSP processing contexts.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 GET Request
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.colbertv2_get_request_v2_wrapped
nodes.description: A wrapper function for making GET requests to a ColBERTv2 service, simplifying API interaction.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 POST Request
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.colbertv2_post_request_v2_wrapped
nodes.description: A wrapper function for making POST requests to a ColBERTv2 service, facilitating data submission.

nodes.label: Format Single Query Passages
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.retrieve.single_query_passage
nodes.description: Transforms a list of passage dictionaries into a standardized DSPy Prediction object for consistent output.

nodes.label: User Query
nodes.title: User Input
nodes.description: The input query provided by the user or another module for document retrieval.

nodes.label: Retrieved Documents
nodes.title: Retrieval Results
nodes.description: The output collection of relevant documents, passages, or embeddings returned by a retriever, potentially with scores.

nodes.label: Databricks Vector Search Index
nodes.title: External Databricks Index
nodes.description: An external Databricks service storing vector embeddings and metadata for efficient search.

nodes.label: Weaviate Collection
nodes.title: External Weaviate Database
nodes.description: An external Weaviate database or collection used for vector search and document storage.

nodes.label: Local ColBERTv2 Index
nodes.title: Local ColBERTv2 Data
nodes.description: A locally managed index for ColBERTv2 retrieval, built from a collection of passages.

nodes.label: Remote ColBERTv2 Service
nodes.title: External ColBERTv2 API
nodes.description: An external service hosting a ColBERTv2 model, providing retrieval capabilities via an API.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing Retrieval Interface
groups.description: Components that provide the primary interface for users to perform document retrieval.

groups.label: Data Retrievers
groups.title: Specific Retrieval Model Implementations
groups.description: Components that implement specific retrieval logic, interacting with various data sources or services.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Reranking and Scored Retrieval
groups.description: Components focused on enhancing retrieval results through reranking or providing additional analytical data like scores.

groups.label: Utility Functions
groups.title: Helper Functions and Wrappers
groups.description: Miscellaneous helper functions and wrappers that support the core retrieval logic or provide text processing capabilities.

adapters_and_retrievers.title: Adapters and Retrievers
adapters_and_retrievers.description: This module equips DSPy programs to interact with external systems and handle diverse data. It provides adapters for structuring various data types and managing LM interactions, alongside a suite of retrievers for fetching relevant information from knowledge bases.

nodes.label: Handle Diverse Data Types
nodes.title: Data Type Adapters
nodes.description: Provides custom data types (e.g., Audio, Image, Code, Tool) to structure and format various data formats for seamless integration with language models, both as input and output.

nodes.label: Manage LM Interactions
nodes.title: System Adapters
nodes.description: Defines how DSPy programs interact with Language Models, handling prompt formatting, output parsing, and integrating advanced features like function calling and multi-stage processing.

nodes.label: Fetch Relevant Information
nodes.title: Retrieval Modules
nodes.description: Offers various retrieval mechanisms (e.g., ColBERTv2, Databricks Vector Search, Weaviate) to efficiently fetch relevant passages or documents from knowledge bases for a given query.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Program/Module
nodes.description: The core DSPy program or module that orchestrates the use of adapters and retrievers to achieve complex tasks involving language models and external data.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Underlying Language Model
nodes.description: The large language model that DSPy programs interact with, receiving formatted prompts and providing raw outputs that need parsing.

nodes.label: External Data Sources
nodes.title: Raw Data Inputs
nodes.description: Various raw data inputs such as images, audio files, code snippets, or documents that need to be structured and adapted for language model consumption.

nodes.label: Knowledge Bases
nodes.title: External Knowledge Repositories
nodes.description: External databases, vector stores, or search indexes (e.g., Databricks, Weaviate) from which retrievers fetch relevant documents or passages.

groups.label: Adapters for Data & LM Interaction
groups.title: Adapters for Data & LM Interaction
groups.description: Components responsible for structuring diverse data types and managing the intricate process of interacting with language models, including prompt formatting and output parsing.

groups.label: Information Retrieval
groups.title: Information Retrieval
groups.description: Modules dedicated to efficiently fetching relevant information from various knowledge bases to provide context for DSPy programs and language models.

groups.label: Core DSPy & External Systems
groups.title: Core DSPy & External Systems
groups.description: Represents the central DSPy program, the underlying language models, and the external data sources and knowledge bases that this module integrates with.
